description:
Description
2020-2023 Hyundai Sonata/2021-2024 Kia K5 FWD floor mats are laser-measured to ensure a perfect fit in your vehicle every time while offering maximum interior protection. Its luxurious finish also complements your vehicle's high-end interior.
Features
• Durability. One of the best things about OEDRO floor mats is that they are developed with strong rubber. This gives them longevity in comparison to other styles of mats. The floor mats are quite flexible. The heavy-duty material is also capable of withstanding constant rubbing and contacting of shoes.
• Excellent Visual Appearance. Adding an all-weather floor liner to your car’s interior will add color and class to your car. The mat’s unique appearance will accentuate the interior look of your car tenfold.
• Protecting the Interior. OEDRO Floor mats offer vehicles perhaps the most comprehensive interior protection in comparison to any other car mat. Your car’s carpet will remain clean and dry at all times.
• Cleaning these Mats is Quite Easy. The materials used for creating floor mats are elementary to wash and clean. You can easily wash and clean the spillage on top of it. You can also spray it using soap and water. Also, there won’t be any odor remaining once the mat dries out.
• It Traps Dirt and Moisture. The waterproof surface of all-weather floor mats makes sure to trap any kind of spillage on top of it. The mats can also trap dust, sand, and other dry particles effectively.
Fitment
Compatible with 2020-2023 Hyundai Sonata.
Compatible with 2021-2024 Kia K5 FWD Models.
Does NOT fit Sonata Hybrid Models.
Specification
BrandOEDRO
MaterialThermoplastic Elastomer
ColorBlack
Product Dimensions31.49"L x 23.62"W x 5.9"Th
Vehicle Service TypePassenger Car
PositionFront Right Inner
Fit TypeCustom Fit
Package Included
Front Matsx2
Rear Linerx1
Installation Manualx1
More Details
Snap-in Clips
Snap the clips into the anchor points on the floor, this will secure the padding group and prevent them from moving or blocking the pedals.
3D Extended Border
The liquid will not be able to overflow the 3D extended edge. TPE material can withstand all weather conditions while preventing rain, snow, liquids, mud, and other dirt from penetrating the carpet. Always keep your car neat and stylish.
Grooved Pattern Texture
Grooved pads on the surface of the Floor mats increase friction to prevent slipping. The heavy-duty TPE material is 100% safe and will not release any toxic substances even in extremely hot or cold weather.
